lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor nineteen. A hundred and seventy megawatts. Be advised the deck's been worked — scaffolding, lighting, someone's generator bolted to Ordinal stone.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Someone's still here?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Someone's on the channel. He asked for you by name.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Captain Vasquez. Marco Ferrar, Sable Reach. I want to open by saying nobody has to shoot anybody today.
lines.beat: Ferrar's first line in the game. Warm, first-name, entirely reasonable.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: You're standing in my anchor.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: I'm standing in an anchor. Ownership is what we're negotiating. Take a moment with it — I'm not in a hurry.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Flak array's cleared for the board. Twenty-two megawatts and it bursts over a lane instead of picking one target — but it still cannot see air on its own.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: That's not me, Captain. That's the local wildlife. I'd deal with it.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Count on that first group — fourteen through the lane and four of them carrying anything at all. The rest were just walking.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Pickets. Day labour, Captain. They cost me almost nothing and they cost you a shot each, which is the arrangement I'd have chosen.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez, the bus. Something out there is pulling off it while it's alive.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Pulling how much?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Eight megawatts a man. They walk in, they cost you, and they don't have to reach the ring to do it.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: You've noticed. Good — I'd have been disappointed. The crews carry a tap, that's all. Cheaper than a rifle and it works on everyone.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: You said nobody has to shoot anybody.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: And nobody has. Look at your board, Captain — you're losing to arithmetic.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Okonkwo. Can we buy back the headroom?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Not on this anchor. Today you leave room on the bus and you kill them fast.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's not our load. They're taking it off us while they walk.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through the ring. Bus reads clear on that one.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Hold the ring. He's counting.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: That was well done. I mean that. Same offer stands — you're not funded for the next twelve anchors and I am.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, log that offer verbatim.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Logged. Meridian Actual has no guidance at this time.
lines.beat: command declines to instruct her — the second time the chain of command goes quiet

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: He knew our capacity before we did. Somebody gave him the survey.
